exercises.day: Day 1 (Mon) - Clean Skill + Front Squat + Knee Capacity
exercises.name: Warm-up: bike + FIFA 11+ prep
exercises.focus: Bike 5 min easy; then FIFA 11+ style dynamic prep, ankle rocks, front-rack + thoracic mobility, deep bodyweight squat holds, 2-3 empty-bar clean drills. This neuromuscular warm-up is injury risk-reduction; do it every session.
exercises.progression: Baseline week. Establish technique and a load you can repeat; nothing progresses yet.

exercises.name: Spanish squat isometric
exercises.focus: Tendon prep (isometric phase of loading). Tolerable knee angle; upright trunk; equal pressure through both feet.
exercises.progression: Baseline week. Establish technique and a load you can repeat; nothing progresses yet.

exercises.day: Day 1 (Mon) - Clean Skill + Front Squat + Knee Capacity
exercises.name: Hang power clean (EMOM every 90s)
exercises.logHint: Top load; bar-path & catch quality; any knee response
exercises.focus: Skill/power. Run as EMOM so it flows rhythmically instead of feeling brief - low reps protect bar speed, the EMOM gives the continuous 'into it' feel. Start above knee; full extension; fast elbows; shallow stable catch; controlled lower to thigh, no dropping. Stop the set if bar path loops or catch destabilises.
exercises.progression: Baseline week. Establish technique and a load you can repeat; nothing progresses yet.

exercises.day: Day 1 (Mon) - Clean Skill + Front Squat + Knee Capacity
exercises.name: Heel-elevated front squat - top set
exercises.logHint: Top load; RPE-1; depth owned Y/N; knee pain during + next AM
exercises.focus: Main lower-body strength + clean receiving position. Heel-elevated (lifting shoes/wedge). If front rack limits an upright torso: use a 2-3 finger grip OR loop straps around the bar as handles. Only use a depth you can own with a vertical torso; no rebound out of the bottom. If the rack position still limits you, sub a heel-elevated Safety-Bar squat at the same RPE.
exercises.progression: Baseline week. Establish technique and a load you can repeat; nothing progresses yet.

exercises.day: Day 1 (Mon) - Clean Skill + Front Squat + Knee Capacity

exercises.logHint: Load; any form/knee change across sets
exercises.focus: Same heel elevation, grip option and depth as the top set. Stop a set the moment depth or knee position degrades.
exercises.progression: Baseline week. Establish technique and a load you can repeat; nothing progresses yet.

exercises.name: Romanian deadlift
